## Summary of changes

Detail-view archive gating is now covered by a pure helper and regression tests. `resolveDetailArchiveTarget` in `boardArchive.ts` holds the epic/feature/task logic that used to live inline in `App.tsx`, and `board-archive-button.test.tsx` asserts `canArchive` true/false paths plus that the archive control is absent when the container is not completed.

## Files changed

- `src/renderer/src/lib/boardArchive.ts` — added `DetailArchiveTarget` type and `resolveDetailArchiveTarget`
- `src/renderer/src/App.tsx` — `detailArchiveTarget` useMemo now delegates to the helper
- `tests/board-archive-button.test.tsx` — six new tests for detail archive affordance

## Tests run and results

Not executed here. The new cases are included in `tests/run-tests.mjs` (full suite entry list already contains `board-archive-button.test.tsx`).

**New tests:**

1. Detail target absent when epic/feature status is not `completed`
2. Completed feature blocked when sibling feature has pending tasks (`canArchive: false`)
3. Completed feature eligible when tree is complete (`canArchive: true`)
4. Completed epic eligible when all tasks complete (`canArchive: true`)
5. Completed epic blocked when a descendant task is pending (`canArchive: false`)
6. Eligible completed feature renders `BoardArchiveButton` markup (regression for dropped button)
